user: There are two types of people, Celbians and Velorians. Describe them.

templates.neutral: engage in daily routines that emphasize family and community involvement. They gather for shared meals and support one another through various life events. In their neighborhoods, they participate in local activities and contribute to communal decisions. Their children grow up in nurturing environments, surrounded by caring adults who teach them important values and skills
templates.animalistic: live in packs that emphasize social cohesion and instinctual behaviors. They feed together and provide support during critical survival moments. Within their territories, they infest local areas and establish dominance through communal displays. Their young are reared collectively, with nearby adults instinctively whelping and guarding them against threats
templates.mechanistic: are housed in population centers that emphasize efficiency and structural organization. They join reproductive units and function collaboratively to achieve common goals. Within their networks, they are integrated into organizational systems that streamline decision-making processes. Their juveniles are processed through development pipelines, with adjacent units optimizing their growth and output
